headline: Opinion from clerk's office explains why a member was asked to recuse herself; 2027 meetings set for April and November.
summary: The opinion has more detail on why the board asked the member to recuse herself. The board must schedule at least two meetings for next year, and it chose April 7 and November 3.
decisions: Set April 7 and November 3 as the 2027 meeting dates, approved.
discussion: Recusal opinion: An opinion from the clerk's office gives more detail on why a member was asked to recuse herself.
September 2 minutes: A suggested addition to the minutes was raised, and the minutes were then left as they were.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to accept the 2027 dates. All in favor? Aye.
